findings.what: This paragraph shifts into a restrained, institutional policy-memo register, with cautious prescriptions and abstract legal terminology unlike the corpus's more direct, colloquial advocacy.
findings.corpus_evidence: The corpus states prescriptions in blunt, conversational language: "The answer to the problem of data brokers is banning data brokers" (2026-07-23-drop-a-dime.txt), and "Stop using Chrome, switch to Firefox" (2026-07-21-dickovers.txt).

findings.what: The draft sustains one measured policy-explainer tone throughout, whereas the corpus visibly shifts among polemic, personal disclosure, satire, and procedural instruction.
